comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-1302 unzips an ESD bag, extracts one battery and seats it upright while leaving the other inside.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires tool regrasping and coordinated screw/nut torque; PR-1302 requires zipper manipulation, selective extraction and orientation-sensitive placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained angular function over repeated cycles; PR-1302 requires the bag opened, one cell seated positive-up, the other retained, and both arms returned.
comparison.reason: Selective unpacking and battery placement have no meaningful adjustment-locking or countertorque requirement; all material rubric details are present.
